<div id="clt-shash-demo" class="clt-layout">

<div class="clt-panel">

<label class="clt-control">
<span>μ</span>
<input
  data-param="mean"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0">
<span data-value="mean"></span>
</label>

<label class="clt-control">
<span>σ</span>
<input
  data-param="sd"
  type="range"
  min="0.5"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1">
<span data-value="sd"></span>
</label>

<label class="clt-control">
<span>Skew</span>
<input
  data-param="skew"
  type="range"
  min="-2"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="1.2">
<span data-value="skew"></span>
</label>

<label class="clt-control">
<span>Kurt.</span>
<input
  data-param="tail"
  type="range"
  min="0.6"
  max="2"
  step="0.1"
  value="0.8">
<span data-value="tail"></span>
</label>

<label class="clt-control">
<span>n</span>
<input
  data-param="n"
  type="range"
  min="1"
  max="100"
  step="1"
  value="10">
<span data-value="n"></span>
</label>

<label class="clt-control">
<span>Reps</span>
<input
  data-param="reps"
  type="range"
  min="100"
  max="5000"
  step="100"
  value="2000">
<span data-value="reps"></span>
</label>

</div>


<div class="clt-plots">

<div class="clt-top">

<div class="clt-plot">
<svg class="clt-population"></svg>
</div>

<div class="clt-plot">
<svg class="clt-replicate-1"></svg>
</div>

<div class="clt-plot">
<svg class="clt-replicate-2"></svg>
</div>

<div class="clt-plot">
<svg class="clt-replicate-3"></svg>
</div>

</div>


<div class="clt-bottom clt-plot">
<svg class="clt-sampling"></svg>
</div>

</div>

</div>

<script>
cltShashDemo("#clt-shash-demo");
</script>
